panels.title: Total volume
panels.description: Total traded volume in BRL for the selected tickers over the dashboard time range. Sums the `voltot` column of the daily COTAHIST parquet (b3_history daily_parse) for rows whose ticker code exactly matches the Ticker variable, across all market types.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT sum(voltot) AS volume
FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_history/daily_parse/*.parquet')
WHERE codneg IN ($ticker)
  AND $__timeFilter(dtpreg::TIMESTAMP)

panels.title: Total trades
panels.description: Total number of trades for the selected tickers over the dashboard time range. Sums the `totneg` (trade count) column of the daily COTAHIST parquet (b3_history daily_parse) for rows matching the Ticker variable, across all market types.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT sum(totneg)::BIGINT AS trades
FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_history/daily_parse/*.parquet')
WHERE codneg IN ($ticker)
  AND $__timeFilter(dtpreg::TIMESTAMP)

panels.title: Instruments traded
panels.description: How many distinct ticker codes from the Ticker variable have at least one row in the daily COTAHIST parquet (b3_history daily_parse) within the time range. A value below the number of selected tickers means some of them did not trade in the period.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT count(DISTINCT codneg) AS instruments
FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_history/daily_parse/*.parquet')
WHERE codneg IN ($ticker)
  AND $__timeFilter(dtpreg::TIMESTAMP)

panels.title: Trading days
panels.description: Number of distinct trading dates (`dtpreg`) in the time range on which at least one of the selected tickers has a row in the daily COTAHIST parquet (b3_history daily_parse).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT count(DISTINCT dtpreg) AS days
FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_history/daily_parse/*.parquet')
WHERE codneg IN ($ticker)
  AND $__timeFilter(dtpreg::TIMESTAMP)

panels.title: $ticker daily candles (cash market)
panels.description: Daily candles (one per trading day) for a single ticker, with traded volume in BRL as bars underneath; the panel repeats once per value selected in the Ticker variable. Open, high, low and close come from `preabe`, `premax`, `premin` and `preult` in the daily COTAHIST parquet (b3_history daily_parse), filtered to the time range. Only cash-market rows (market type 010) are used, and prices are raw BRL quotes, not adjusted for splits or dividends.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  dtpreg::TIMESTAMP AS time,
  preabe AS open,
  premax AS high,
  premin AS low,
  preult AS close,
  voltot AS volume
FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_history/daily_parse/*.parquet')
WHERE codneg = $ticker
  AND tpmerc = '010'
  AND $__timeFilter(dtpreg::TIMESTAMP)
ORDER BY time

panels.title: Daily volume by market
panels.description: Daily traded volume in BRL for the selected tickers, shown as stacked bars by market type. Sums `voltot` from the daily COTAHIST parquet (b3_history daily_parse) per trading day, grouping the `tpmerc` codes into Cash (010), Odd lot (020), Options (070/080), Option exercise (012/013), Forward (030), Auction (017) and Futures (050/060). Filtered by the Ticker variable (exact ticker code match) and the time range.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  dtpreg::TIMESTAMP AS time,
  sum(voltot) FILTER (WHERE tpmerc = '010') AS "Cash",
  sum(voltot) FILTER (WHERE tpmerc = '020') AS "Odd lot",
  sum(voltot) FILTER (WHERE tpmerc IN ('070', '080')) AS "Options",
  sum(voltot) FILTER (WHERE tpmerc IN ('012', '013')) AS "Option exercise",
  sum(voltot) FILTER (WHERE tpmerc = '030') AS "Forward",
  sum(voltot) FILTER (WHERE tpmerc = '017') AS "Auction",
  sum(voltot) FILTER (WHERE tpmerc IN ('050', '060')) AS "Futures"
FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_history/daily_parse/*.parquet')
WHERE codneg IN ($ticker)
  AND $__timeFilter(dtpreg::TIMESTAMP)
GROUP BY time
ORDER BY time

panels.title: Top 20 by volume (cash market, range)
panels.description: Unfiltered top 20 tickers by traded volume (BRL) in the cash market (market type 010) over the time range; the Ticker variable is ignored. Aggregates the daily COTAHIST parquet (b3_history daily_parse) per ticker: name, share type, total trades, total volume, closing price (`preult`) on the first and last trading day in range, and the return between those two closes. Closes are raw prices, not adjusted for splits or dividends.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  codneg AS ticker,
  any_value(nomres) AS name,
  any_value(especi) AS spec,
  sum(totneg)::BIGINT AS trades,
  sum(voltot) AS volume,
  arg_min(preult, dtpreg) AS first_close,
  arg_max(preult, dtpreg) AS last_close,
  arg_max(preult, dtpreg) / arg_min(preult, dtpreg) - 1 AS period_return
FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_history/daily_parse/*.parquet')
WHERE tpmerc = '010'
  AND $__timeFilter(dtpreg::TIMESTAMP)
GROUP BY codneg
ORDER BY volume DESC
LIMIT 20

panels.title: Top gainers (standard lot, avg R$ 1M/day)
panels.description: Top 15 tickers by highest period return over the time range, among cash-market (type 010), standard-lot (BDI code 02) rows averaging at least BRL 1M traded volume per trading day. Return is the last close divided by the first close in range, minus 1, using raw `preult` from the daily COTAHIST parquet (b3_history daily_parse), not adjusted for splits or dividends. Unfiltered top-N: the Ticker variable is ignored.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  codneg AS ticker,
  arg_max(preult, dtpreg) AS last_close,
  arg_max(preult, dtpreg) / arg_min(preult, dtpreg) - 1 AS period_return
FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_history/daily_parse/*.parquet')
WHERE tpmerc = '010'
  AND codbdi = '02'
  AND $__timeFilter(dtpreg::TIMESTAMP)
GROUP BY codneg
HAVING avg(voltot) >= 1000000
ORDER BY period_return DESC
LIMIT 15

panels.title: Top losers (standard lot, avg R$ 1M/day)
panels.description: Top 15 tickers by lowest period return over the time range, among cash-market (type 010), standard-lot (BDI code 02) rows averaging at least BRL 1M traded volume per trading day. Return is the last close divided by the first close in range, minus 1, using raw `preult` from the daily COTAHIST parquet (b3_history daily_parse), not adjusted for splits or dividends. Unfiltered top-N: the Ticker variable is ignored.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  codneg AS ticker,
  arg_max(preult, dtpreg) AS last_close,
  arg_max(preult, dtpreg) / arg_min(preult, dtpreg) - 1 AS period_return
FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_history/daily_parse/*.parquet')
WHERE tpmerc = '010'
  AND codbdi = '02'
  AND $__timeFilter(dtpreg::TIMESTAMP)
GROUP BY codneg
HAVING avg(voltot) >= 1000000
ORDER BY period_return ASC
LIMIT 15
